output.interpretation: Liver gene expression in mice fed a NASH-inducing diet (e.g., high-fat/high-fructose/high-cholesterol, CDAHFD, MCD, GAN/AMLN diet) versus chow-fed control mice — a two-group comparison of NASH-diet liver vs chow liver in mouse.
output.out_of_scope: The question asks about mice (Mus musculus). Only human bulk RNA-seq series with NCBI-generated raw counts qualify, so no qualifying series can answer a mouse diet-model question. A human analogue would compare liver biopsies from NASH/MASH patients with liver biopsies from people with normal liver histology, but that is a different question.
